title: BADF-AET-A: freeze the Agentic Engineer Team runtime contract -- four planes, persistent seats, non-expansion invariants, durable effects, badf init integration
objective: Freeze the normative AET contract (docs/14) so every later runtime rung (AET-B..E) builds against declared invariants instead of accumulated convention -- the contract only; no runtime, no schemas, no registry entry, no authority change.
business_value: The AET program intake (#236) ratified D1 after its three-leg trigger closed at d910e12; the contract is the smallest correct governed unit, and freezing it first is the ladder discipline every capability family in this repo has followed (A-rung before substrate).
in_scope: docs/14-agentic-engineer-team.md: the normative contract -- four planes with per-plane authority sentences; six persistent seats + dynamic-specialist rule; routing rules; invariants AET-I01..I12 (non-expansion, no self-approval, output!=authority, durable-effect PREPARE->AUTHORITY->COMMIT->RECONCILE with the five outcome classes, bounded retries + stop codes, session resume protocol, evidence correlation, learning-never-expands-authority, human-reserved untouched by pointer not copy, badf init team-profile subset invariant, one canonical gate); budgets and stop codes; the badf init integration contract; rungs A-E with explicit gating incl. P1-before-P3
AGENTS.md: one required-reading row pointing agentic-team runtime work at docs/14 (a pointer, not authority)

tests/test_badf_aet_contract.py: red-first content-anchor guards per the house REFERENCE_ANCHORS remedy (planes, seats, invariant ids, all five outcome classes as a non-empty reference list, the AGENTS.md row, rung gating, and the absence guard: the contract must POINT at badf/authority-matrix.json rather than restate the human-reserved list)
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0108.json; GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; reconcile WP-2026-0117; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: any AET-B..E content: no runtime code, no team schema, no coordinator adapter, no shadow -- the rungs are DEFINED and GATED here, not built

badf/skill-registry.json (the AET is operating doctrine, not a routed capability; also keeps this WP off the most-contended surface), badf/authority-matrix.json, badf/lifecycle.json (authority-policy mutation explicitly out of scope per the ratified packet)
badf/team.yaml or any INIT-rung artifact; the D4 throughput question (stays with the #236 conversation)
acceptance_criteria: docs/14 exists and declares: all four planes, all six persistent seats, invariants AET-I01..I12, all five durable-effect outcome classes, the badf init subset invariant, and rungs B-E each with an explicit gate/trigger
AGENTS.md carries the docs/14 required-reading row; no other AGENTS.md content changes
the contract references badf/authority-matrix.json for human-reserved authority and does NOT restate the role list (drift guard: a copy would fork the law)
guard tests red before the document exists, green after; gutting the invariants section, an outcome class, or the AGENTS.md row turns a test red (mutation evidence in the PR)
repo PASS on branch and composed tree; no diff outside the declared surface (the two-sided containment control judges this record)

test_obligations.claim: the frozen contract carries its load-bearing declarations and the normative root references it; anchors cannot be gutted silently

evidence: failing-first: all guard tests red before docs/14 exists
green: module green after the freeze
mutation: invariants section / outcome class / AGENTS.md row neutered -> red

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
